segments.t: Every item in korTTY's menu bar, with its shortcut (where defined) and what it does. The menu bar can be hidden with KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004+KTPH005KTPH001KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH002KTPH008 and shown again by right-clicking the terminal or status bar.
Open Quick Connect in a new terminal tab
Close every tab in the current window
Open an additional, independent main window
Restore a saved project (windows, tabs, layout)
Save the current session as a project (KTPH000)
Create an encrypted backup (ZIP password or GPG)
Connection entries (Quick Connect, Manage/Import/Export Connections) live in the KTPH000ConnectionsKTPH001 menu.
Search the active tab (terminal scrollback or open editor)
Connect to a host without saving
Open the Connection Manager (tree, search, edit)
Open the dual-panel SFTP file manager
Manage GPG keys used for backup encryption
Review, search and remove trusted SSH host keys
Open the global Settings dialog (all tabs)

On macOS and Windows, enable activity-based system-sleep prevention. The computer is kept awake only while a terminal is connected, an enabled Scheduler job has a future run or is running, or an AI request is in progress. With none of these activities, system sleep remains available even while the item is checked. Display sleep is unaffected. On Linux the item is visible but disabled.
See the KTPH000Settings referenceKTPH001 for every individual setting.
Create, edit, organize, send and export command snippets in one workspace: the library and the snippets you edit as tabs, each with its stored Full code analysis
Schedule background command / snippet / AI-agent / AI-swarm / SFTP / Rsync jobs
Manage terminal recordings and export to WebM/MKV via KTPH000
Toggle recording of the active terminal (KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004+KTPH005KTPH001KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH002KTPH008)
Manage KTPH003session journalsKTPH004: search, open, rename, describe, export and delete them, and set the journal options (KTPH005KTPH000KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH001KTPH008+KTPH009KTPH002KTPH010)
Toggle the session journal of the active terminal tab; starting mid-session imports the existing scrollback (KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004+KTPH005KTPH001KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH002KTPH008)
Snapshot the active terminal into its running session journal (KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004+KTPH005KTPH001KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH002KTPH008)
Two tabs in one dialog: KTPH000Text BannerKTPH001 renders text as a FIGlet banner in multiple font styles, KTPH002AI PictureKTPH003 lets an AI profile draw a subject as ASCII art
The three session-journal items stay visible but are disabled when an KTPH000enterprise policyKTPH001 denies the session-journal feature.
Manage AI profiles, integrated GGUF models, RAG knowledge stores, the AI Skills library, and Text/Coding roles
Open the saved AI chat conversations directly in their own window; invoking it again brings the existing window to the front
Broadcast one AI task to many servers and compare the answers (KTPH003KTPH000KTPH004+KTPH005KTPH001KTPH006+KTPH007KTPH002KTPH008)

KTPH000AI ManagerKTPH001 opens as a modeless window, so it can remain visible while you use the main window. Invoking it again restores and focuses the same manager for that main window instead of creating a duplicate. Its five sections are KTPH002ProfilesKTPH003 (connection mode, model, prompt preset, reasoning, internet access and token budget), KTPH004Local ModelsKTPH005 (search/download/import GGUF models), KTPH006Knowledge StoresKTPH007 (RAG sources), KTPH008AI SkillsKTPH009 (the skill library, moved here from the global settings dialog) and KTPH010Local AIKTPH011 (Text/Coding/embedding roles and the local runtime). The open primary section remains marked by a bold accent underline after you move focus into its tables, fields, or buttons:
Dock the local KTPH000file browserKTPH001 to the left of the terminal; unchecking the active side hides it
Dock the local KTPH000file browserKTPH001 to the right of the terminal; unchecking the active side hides it

Slider (0–100 %) that makes the terminal background see-through to the desktop while the text stays sharp; every split pane inherits the value. The value is saved across restarts; fullscreen temporarily renders terminal backgrounds opaque and restores the value when you leave. Switching it on or off needs a restart, so the status bar shows a hint when you cross that threshold. Shown in the in-window menu bar only.
Show the whole korTTY window — menus, tabs and status bar included — kept at its previous window size and centered on an empty fullscreen background, hiding the desktop and other windows
Also hide scrollbars while in fullscreen
AI Agent Panel ▸ At Bottom / Dock Left / Dock Right
Choose where the AI agent activity panel lives
Live Journal ▸ Dock Left / Dock Right
Dock the KTPH000live journal panelKTPH001 beside the terminal; selecting the active side hides it
Toggle the live journal panel on its last-used side (right by default)
Coding Agents ▸ Dock Left / Dock Right
Dock the KTPH000Coding Agents panelKTPH001 beside the terminal; selecting the active side hides it
Toggle the Coding Agents panel on its last-used side (right by default)
Bring the next coding agent that is waiting for a decision to the front, across windows
Configure shared connection sources and synchronization

The manual has its own text-size buttons at the top left of its window: KTPH000, the current percentage, and KTPH001. Clicking the percentage resets it. The same three actions have keyboard shortcuts: KTPH008KTPH002KTPH009+KTPH010KTPH003KTPH011, KTPH012KTPH004KTPH013+KTPH014KTPH005KTPH015, KTPH016KTPH006KTPH017+KTPH018KTPH007KTPH019. korTTY remembers the size, and the size covers the whole window — the page and, when it is open, the AI search panel beside it. See KTPH020Manual text sizeKTPH021.

Screenshots and diagrams enlarge on click: the picture opens over the page at the largest size the window allows, with KTPH002−KTPH003 / KTPH004+KTPH005 buttons and a percentage that returns it to that fitted size. Zoom further to read a single setting row, drag the picture to pan, and close with the KTPH006×KTPH007, KTPH008KTPH000KTPH009 or a click next to the picture. KTPH010KTPH001KTPH011 and the wheel zoom as well. The same works in the online guide.

On macOS the packaged app keeps running in the background (so the JobScheduler can run scheduled jobs) even after the last window is closed. korTTY therefore adds two extra entry points so it stays reachable — and quittable — with no window open:

KTPH000Dock icon menuKTPH001 — right-click korTTY's Dock icon for quick actions: KTPH002New WindowKTPH003, KTPH004New TabKTPH005, KTPH006Manage Connections…KTPH007, KTPH008Open Project…KTPH009, KTPH010ManualKTPH011, KTPH012About korTTYKTPH013, and KTPH014QuitKTPH015.
KTPH000Menu-bar (status) iconKTPH001 — a system-tray icon with KTPH002New WindowKTPH003 and KTPH004QuitKTPH005; clicking the icon opens a new window.
Both provide a reliable KTPH000QuitKTPH001 even when every window is closed.
